name: Fantasy Legend. The Frozen Century
detailed_description:
This game is a Japanese RPG-style adventure game. Could the disaster that began on the frozen island that had been sealed for a thousand years, destroyed the peace of the continents for several years, and swept across the entire world be stopped in advance? A thousand years later, people will sigh at this moment. They will say: If someone can do something at this moment, will nothing happen next?

As the investigator appointed by the kingdom, can you and your companions successfully investigate the truth and prevent this

Because of the unknown disaster, the friendship among relatives and friends, the country and the nation, for the sake of the master and the country, we must never give up!

This game has a total of 3 endings, each with a different game time. It requires crucial choices and exploration to achieve. This game can be replayed, and other endings will not affect the experience. Moreover, the main storyline of this game contains a large number of murder mystery puzzle-solving elements. Players can collect clues and uncover the truth while freely exploring. This game has an automatic save function, so you can play it with peace of mind.

short_description: In this game, you will meet new companions on your journey and fight with them to explore the truth from a thousand years ago. The rich plot performance, vivid combat experience and various branch plots will allow you to deeply immerse yourself in that special world.
